sections.description: Narrow, logged abilities for Blue Collar Marketing's Claude workflows.
sections.changelog:
1.2.3

bcm/get-site-identity reports the installed BCM Agency Tools version, for checking rollouts.

1.2.2

clearer next-step message after adding a tracking code (service-specific check; purge only mentioned when the code isn't live yet).

1.2.1

after adding a tracking code, clear page caches the way WPCode's own save does (plus Breeze/Varnish), and store the block in WPCode's slashed format. New `bcm/purge-page-cache`.

1.2.0

tracking codes now go into WPCode's Header & Footer fields (live instantly, no snippet cache), as marked BCM blocks.

1.1.1

refresh WPCode's snippet cache after adding a tracking code, then confirm it's on the live homepage (reports `live_on_homepage`).
